verilog_input.description: input VERILOG file, provide circuit netlist information if it is not included in DEF file

num_bins_x.description: number of bins in horizontal direction; computed by internal heuristic if not specified

num_bins_y.description: number of bins in vertical direction; computed by internal heuristic if not specified

global_place_stages.description: global placement configurations of each stage, a dictionary of {"num_bins_x", "num_bins_y", "iteration", "learning_rate", "learning_rate_decay", "wirelength", "optimizer", "Llambda_density_weight_iteration", "Lsub_iteration"}. optimizer can be one of the following: nesterov, adam, sgd, rmsprop, adagrad, adadelta, adamax, adamw, nadam, yogi, radam, adabelief, adabound, adafactor, diffgrad, novograd, cg_fr, cg_prp, cg_hs, cg_cd, cg_ls, cg_dy, cg_hz, cg_hs-dy. The default optimizer is nesterov. Convergence is not guaranteed when using other optimizers.

scale_factor.description: scale factor to avoid numerical overflow; 0.0 means not set

shift_factor.description: shift factor to avoid numerical issues when the lower-left origin of rows is not (0, 0);

ignore_net_degree.description: ignore net degree larger than some value

gp_noise_ratio.description: noise to initial positions for global placement

stop_overflow.description: stopping criteria, consider stop when the overflow reaches to a ratio

detailed_place_engine.description: external detailed placement engine to be called after placement

detailed_place_command.description: commands for external detailed placement engine

RePlAce_ref_hpwl.description: reference HPWL used in RePlAce for updating density weight

RePlAce_LOWER_PCOF.description: lower bound ratio used in RePlAce for updating density weight

RePlAce_UPPER_PCOF.description: upper bound ratio used in RePlAce for updating density weight

gamma.description: base coefficient for log-sum-exp and weighted-average wirelength, a relative value to bin size

RePlAce_skip_energy_flag.description: whether skip density energy computation for fast mode, may not work with some solvers

random_center_init_flag.description: whether perform random initialization around the center for global placement

gift_init_flag.description: whether perform GiFt initialization for global placement

sort_nets_by_degree.description: whether sort nets by degree or not

dump_global_place_solution_flag.description: whether dump intermediate global placement solution as a compressed pickle object

dump_legalize_solution_flag.description: whether dump intermediate legalization solution as a compressed pickle object

node_area_adjust_overflow.description: the overflow where to adjust node area

max_num_area_adjust.description: maximum times to adjust node area

adjust_nctugr_area_flag.description: whether use NCTUgr congestion map to guide area adjustment

adjust_rudy_area_flag.description: whether use RUDY/RISA map to guide area adjustment

adjust_pin_area_flag.description: whether use pin utilization map to guide area adjustment

unit_horizontal_capacity.description: number of horizontal routing tracks per unit distance

unit_vertical_capacity.description: number of vertical routing tracks per unit distance

unit_pin_capacity.description: number of pins per unit area

route_opt_adjust_exponent.description: exponent to adjust the routing utilization map

deterministic_flag.description: whether require run-to-run determinism, may have efficiency overhead

ruplace_xplace_root.description: path to Xplace repository used as external GPU-router adapter

ruplace_gpugr_root.description: path to bundled/built GPUGR root; empty auto-detects the installed DREAMPlace bundle

ruplace_router_backend.description: GPU router backend for standalone GPUGR/RUPlace; supported values are gpugr, xplace, and instantgr

ruplace_instantgr_root.description: path to optional InstantGR third-party repository

ruplace_instantgr_binary.description: path to optional InstantGR executable; empty uses ruplace_instantgr_root/run/InstantGR

ruplace_instantgr_cap_input.description: native InstantGR .cap input for standalone instantgr backend; LEF/DEF export is not implemented in v1

ruplace_instantgr_net_input.description: native InstantGR .net input for standalone instantgr backend; LEF/DEF export is not implemented in v1

ruplace_gr_rrr_iters.description: GGR rip-up and reroute iterations for RUPlace route evaluations

ruplace_route_gpu.description: CUDA device id used by the Xplace GPU-router adapter

ruplace_external_route_eval.description: run Xplace GGR in a subprocess to avoid CUDA context corruption during placement

ruplace_inflate_start_overflow.description: density overflow threshold to start RUPlace inflation; negative uses node_area_adjust_overflow

ruplace_max_inflate_ratio.description: maximum cell inflation ratio used by RUPlace

ruplace_min_inflate_ratio.description: minimum cumulative cell inflation ratio used by RUPlace local adjustment

ruplace_global_inflate_gamma.description: damping factor for RUPlace global clustered inflation

ruplace_global_cluster_mode.description: global RUPlace inflation aggregation mode: mean, max, or none

ruplace_global_util_exponent.description: exponent applied to global route utilization excess before RUPlace inflation

ruplace_local_inflate_gamma.description: smoothing factor for RUPlace local cell area adjustment

ruplace_inflate_area_cap.description: maximum movable-area growth fraction per RUPlace inflation round

ruplace_inflate_extra_capacity.description: extra movable-area budget allowed for RUPlace inflation when filler whitespace is unavailable

ruplace_congested_uniform_inflate_ratio.description: fallback uniform inflation ratio when GGR reports congestion but center-bin utilization gives no positive inflation target

ruplace_node_util_window.description: neighboring routing-bin radius used to max-smooth RUPlace node utilization before inflation

ruplace_node_util_blend.description: blend between center-bin and max-smoothed utilization when ruplace_node_util_window is positive

ruplace_hv_inflate_gamma.description: extra inflation pressure from H/V route overflow maps; 0 disables directional H/V-aware inflation

ruplace_hv_inflate_mode.description: how to combine horizontal and vertical overflow for H/V-aware inflation: max, mean, sum, h, or v

ruplace_allow_shrink.description: allow RUPlace local adjustment to shrink over-inflated cells back toward the minimum inflation ratio

ruplace_local_congestion_stop.description: route overflow threshold to stop RUPlace local inflation

ruplace_local_ovfl_nets_stop.description: maximum overflow-net count treated as congestion-free for RUPlace local inflation

ruplace_local_est_shorts_stop.description: maximum estimated-short count treated as congestion-free for RUPlace local inflation

ruplace_admm_start_overflow.description: density overflow threshold to start RUPlace ADMM routed-wire refinement

ruplace_admm_route_freq.description: placement iterations between RUPlace ADMM route refreshes

ruplace_admm_apply_freq.description: placement iterations between applying RUPlace ADMM route gradients

ruplace_admm_weight.description: weight for RUPlace routed-wire ADMM gradient

ruplace_admm_weight_decay.description: multiplicative decay applied to RUPlace ADMM gradient weight after each application

ruplace_admm_min_weight.description: minimum RUPlace ADMM gradient weight after decay; 0 disables the floor

ruplace_admm_grad_clip_norm.description: global norm used to clip RUPlace ADMM route gradients before weighting; 0 disables clipping

ruplace_admm_anchor_weight.description: anchor penalty weight for RUPlace ADMM route gradient

ruplace_admm_anchor_update.description: anchor update policy for RUPlace ADMM route gradient: refresh, static, or ema

ruplace_admm_anchor_decay.description: EMA decay for RUPlace ADMM anchor update when ruplace_admm_anchor_update is ema

timing_opt_flag.description: whether to turn on timing-driven optimization flag in global placement

early_lib_input.description: input early cell library file(s); accepts a string or string array
early_lib_input.required: required for timing-driven mode (together with late lib)

late_lib_input.description: input late cell library file(s); accepts a string or string array
late_lib_input.required: required for timing-driven mode (together with early lib)

lib_input.description: input shared cell library file(s) for early and late; accepts a string or string array
lib_input.required: required for timing-driven mode (or separate early/late libs)

momentum_decay_factor.description: the decay factor used in momemtum iteration

enable_net_weighting.description: enable net weighting during global placement

max_net_weight.description: maximum net weight in timing opt (negative for infinity)

two_stage_density_scaler.description: scale density weight after macro place
